title: distribution_summary: return quartile, skewness, and outlier stats for a numeric column
description: Return min, Q1, median, Q3, max, std, skewness, and IQR-based outlier count for a numeric column. Helps identify whether data is skewed or has extreme outliers.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Name of the numeric column to analyze.

rag_note: Column must be numeric. Returns stat/value rows including skew_label (symmetric / right-skewed / left-skewed). Use when observation signals data_quality_issue or suspected_wrong_value.
